scientific_integrity: The proof uses a direct trace-ideal comparison, nonzero Gram spectra, positivity, and dominated convergence. Numerical finite-atomic tests are only supplementary. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive measures on (0,∞) with finite inverse moment; rate O(sqrt(ε)) not stated to be sharp; existing smooth gamma special case and wider priority risk acknowledged.
title: Measure-universal trace-norm spectral scaling of positive Helson matrices
